must_find.what: A bare ":" between a time-only result and a following date-only result is accepted as a connector, so a lone number such as "24" followed by ":" merges backwards over the date, yields an invalid 24 o'clock result that is dropped, and takes the real date with it ("24: July 23, 2026 at 3:30 PM" parses as only "at 3:30 PM").
